report_name: Microsoft & Apple Patch Critical Flaws, Including CVSS 10.0 Bugs

vulnerabilities.name: CVE-2026-63508
vulnerabilities.description: A missing authentication vulnerability in Microsoft Planetary Computer Pro that could lead to privilege escalation.

vulnerabilities.name: CVE-2026-56162
vulnerabilities.description: An improper authentication issue in Azure SQL Database, allowing for privilege escalation.

vulnerabilities.name: CVE-2026-65667
vulnerabilities.description: A missing authorization vulnerability in Microsoft Teams. Microsoft patched this on the server-side, so no end-user action is required.

vulnerabilities.name: CVE-2026-50515
vulnerabilities.description: A remote code execution (RCE) vulnerability in Azure Service Bus.

vulnerabilities.name: CVE-2026-62830
vulnerabilities.description: An elevation of privilege (EoP) vulnerability in Azure SRE Agent.

vulnerabilities.name: CVE-2026-59115
vulnerabilities.description: An elevation of privilege (EoP) vulnerability in Microsoft Entra Provisioning Service.

vulnerabilities.name: CVE-2026-50481
vulnerabilities.description: An elevation of privilege (EoP) vulnerability in Active Directory.

vulnerabilities.name: CVE-2026-65400
vulnerabilities.description: An authentication bypass vulnerability in the Screen Sharing feature of macOS which could allow a remote attacker on the same network to gain access to a user's screen without providing valid credentials.

vulnerabilities.name: Google Chrome Use-After-Free Vulnerabilities (August 2026)
vulnerabilities.description: Google released an update for Chrome 151 fixing 41 flaws, including six critical use-after-free vulnerabilities.

indicators.name: Suspicious Child Process of macOS Screen Sharing Daemon
indicators.pattern:
title: Suspicious Child Process of macOS Screen Sharing Daemon
id: 2b8a1c9d-e4f5-4a1b-8c7d-9e0f1a2b3c4d
status: experimental
description: Detects unexpected child processes spawned by the macOS Screen Sharing daemon (screensharingd), which could indicate exploitation of an authentication bypass like CVE-2026-65400.
references:
  - https://www.securityweek.com/microsoft-apple-release-fresh-security-updates/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-08
tags:
  - attack.t1548
level: medium
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: macos
detection:
  selection:
    ParentImage|endswith: '/screensharingd'
  filter_known_good:
    Image|endswith:
      - '/System/Library/CoreServices/RemoteManagement/ARDAgent.app/Contents/MacOS/ARDAgent'
  condition: selection and not filter_known_good
indicators.description: Monitors for unexpected child processes originating from the `screensharingd` process on macOS, which could indicate exploitation of vulnerabilities like CVE-2026-65400.

indicators.name: Anomalous Connection to macOS Screen Sharing Port
indicators.pattern:
title: Anomalous Connection to macOS Screen Sharing Port
id: 8d1e2f3a-b4c5-4d6e-8f9a-0b1c2d3e4f5a
status: experimental
description: 'Detects unusual network connections to port 5900 (VNC/Screen Sharing) on macOS devices, which may indicate attempts to exploit vulnerabilities like CVE-2026-65400.'
references:
  - https://www.securityweek.com/microsoft-apple-release-fresh-security-updates/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-08
tags:
  - attack.t1021
level: low
logsource:
  category: network_connection
  product: macos
detection:
  selection:
    DestinationPort: 5900
  filter_local:
    DestinationIp|cidr:
      - '127.0.0.0/8'
      - '::1/128'
  condition: selection and not filter_local
indicators.description: Monitors for unusual or unauthorized connection attempts to port 5900 (VNC/Screen Sharing) on macOS devices.

indicators.name: Potential Active Directory Privilege Escalation Attempt
indicators.pattern:
title: Potential Active Directory Privilege Escalation Attempt
id: 5a6b7c8d-9e0f-4a1b-8c2d-3e4f5a6b7c8d
status: experimental
description: 'Monitors for anomalous privilege escalation events in Active Directory, such as special privileges being assigned to non-administrative accounts, which could indicate exploitation of vulnerabilities like CVE-2026-50481.'
references:
  - https://www.securityweek.com/microsoft-apple-release-fresh-security-updates/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-08
tags:
  - attack.t1068
level: medium
logsource:
  product: windows
  service: security
detection:
  selection:
    EventID: 4672 # Special privileges assigned to new logon
  filter_admins:
    AccountName|endswith:
      - 'Administrator'
      - '$' # Exclude machine accounts
  condition: selection and not filter_admins
indicators.description: Monitors for unusual privilege escalation events or modifications related to service accounts in Active Directory logs, potentially indicating exploitation of CVE-2026-50481.
